text: In cubical type theory, the 'fill' operation is related to 'hcomp' by:
choices: fill gives the entire path (filling a box) while hcomp gives only the top face
fill is the inverse of hcomp
explanation: hcomp u u0 : A i1 gives the top face. fill u u0 : ∀ i → A i gives the entire path (the whole box). fill(u)(u0)(i) = hcomp (λ j → ...) u0 with a suitable truncation.
